changelog: Adds Sideload Update: upload a .tar.gz release file directly through the control page, for when the device has no real internet access (stuck on its own setup hotspot, for instance) - the normal Check for Firmware Update needs the device itself to reach GitHub, which a hotspot alone can never provide. Goes through the exact same verification, install, and rollback-on-failure pipeline as a normal update; run_update.py's core logic was refactored to discover a release's version from its own bundled release-manifest.json rather than always trusting a value fetched from GitHub, which is what makes sideloading possible without a separate update-manifest.json to consult.
